newsitem.title: USA: Negotiated muni bond sales total $155 mln Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Negotiated muni bond sales total $155 mln Thursday.

text.p: NEW YORK, Sept 18 (Reuter) 0 Scheduled negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $154.9 million in six offerings on Thursday, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
The largest issue is expected to be a $100 million Honolulu, Hawaii, deal via Smith Barney Inc.
An additional $63 million of deals are on the Reuters possible negotiated calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may decide to price the issues depending on market conditions.
